description: Du suchst keinen klassischen Job. Du suchst die maximale Herausforderung und ein Umfeld, das so ambitioniert ist wie Du. Die WTE Group baut und skaliert Unternehmen gegen den Fachkräftemangel. Mit WTE Charkos bringen wir Pflegefachkräfte aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Gespräch und einem eigenen Ausbildungszentrum in Mysore. Charkos wächst gegen den Markttrend. Mit WTE Companion entwickeln wir die App, die internationalen Fachkräften und Studenten das Ankommen in Deutschland abnimmt, von der Wohnung bis zum Bankkonto. Und mit unserem eigenen Software- und KI-Team bauen wir gerade ein Venture Studio auf, das neue KI-Produkte für die Branchen entwickelt, die wir aus dem Tagesgeschäft kennen. Dafür suchen wir die rechte Hand der beiden Gründer. Zunächst heißt das: Du arbeitest direkt mit uns, nimmst uns die Themen ab, die zwischen Strategie und Tagesgeschäft liegen, und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen fallen und umgesetzt werden. Wer das zwei bis drei Jahre auf Top-Niveau macht, hat alles gelernt, um danach selbst ein Venture der Gruppe zu führen. Was Du bei uns machst Rechte Hand der Gründer: Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, hältst die Fäden zwischen Hamburg, Mysore und unseren Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt, was die Geschäftsführung angestoßen hat. Sonderprojekte: Finanzierung, Partnerverhandlungen mit Banken und Versicherern, Ausschreibungen, Aufbau neuer Teams und Standorte. Du übernimmst, was gerade am wichtigsten ist, und bringst es zu Ende. Operative Exzellenz: Du übersetzt Strategie in Routinen, Zahlen und Prozesse, damit die Gruppe mit jedem neuen Venture stabiler wird statt chaotischer. Business Development: Du erkennst Wachstumschancen, baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und treibst Deals eigenständig bis zur Unterschrift. Venture Building: Du begleitest neue Produkte und Ventures aus dem Studio vom ersten Businessplan bis zur Marktreife, egal ob KI-Software oder Dienstleistung. Sparringspartner: Du forderst die Gründer heraus, lieferst Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf den Punkt und filterst, was wirklich auf den Tisch der Geschäftsführung gehört. Was Du mitbringst Exzellente Ausbildung: Studium mit herausragenden Ergebnissen, gern an einer der führenden Hochschulen. Nachgewiesene Spitzenleistung: Du hast schon einmal bewiesen, dass Du zu den Besten gehörst. Das muss kein wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund sein: Spitzensport, Musik, eine eigene Gründung oder ein anderes Feld mit höchstem Leistungsanspruch zählen genauso. Intelligenz und Hunger: Brillante Auffassungsgabe, unternehmerisches Denken und der feste Wille, in Zukunft selbst zu gründen. Macher-Mentalität: Du willst Dinge bewegen und tauchst ohne Scheu tief in die operative Umsetzung ein, vom Vertragsentwurf bis zur Excel-Tabelle. Technik-Affinität: Du musst nicht programmieren, aber Du verstehst, was KI heute kann, und arbeitest selbstverständlich damit. Kommunikation: Deutsch und Englisch auf Top-Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich. Unsere Teams sitzen in Hamburg und Indien. Was wir bieten Das Sprungbrett zur eigenen Gründung: Du lernst in zwei bis drei Jahren, wie man mehrere Unternehmen parallel aufbaut, finanziert und führt. Besser kann man sich auf die eigene Gründung nicht vorbereiten. Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den beiden Gründern, kurze Wege, keine Zwischenebene. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Ambitionierte, intelligente Menschen in Hamburg und Mysore, die gemeinsam etwas Großes aufbauen wollen. Perspektive: Die Chance, bei zukünftigen Ventures der Gruppe direkt in den Driver’s Seat zu rücken. Arbeitsplatz: Wunderschönes, modernes Büro in Hamburg-Winterhude. Vergiss das Standard-Anschreiben. title: Head of Sales (m/w/d)
description: WTE Charkos bringt Pflegefachkräfte und Auszubildende aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Auswahlgespräch und einem eigenen Ausbildungs- und Sprachzentrum in Mysore. Unsere Kunden sind Universitätskliniken, kommunale und private Klinikträger und Altenpflege-Träger in ganz Deutschland. Wir tragen das RAL-Gütezeichen „Faire Anwerbung Pflege Deutschland” und arbeiten als anerkannter Dienstleister mit dem Freistaat Thüringen zusammen. Unser Modell funktioniert: Wir wachsen gegen den Markttrend, immer mehr Einrichtungen setzen auf unsere Fachkräfte und planen Folgekohorten mit uns. Damit das so bleibt, wollen wir unseren Vertrieb verstetigen und professionalisieren. Dafür suchen wir Dich: für unser Team in Deutschland und Indien, mit Büro in Hamburg. Was Du bei uns machst Neukunden: Du gewinnst neue Kunden in der Altenpflege und im Klinikmarkt: Träger mit mehreren Häusern, Klinikverbünde, Universitätskliniken. Outbound-Prozess: Du baust einen wiederholbaren Outbound-Prozess auf (Telefon, Mail, LinkedIn, Besuche vor Ort) und führst ihn selbst, statt ihn nur zu steuern. Abschluss: Du führst Erstgespräche, Bedarfsanalysen und Angebotsgespräche mit Geschäftsführung, Pflegedirektion und Personalleitung bis zur Unterschrift. Bestandskunden: Du entwickelst Kunden zu Folgekohorten und begleitest Ausschreibungen gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung. Pipeline: Du pflegst Pipeline und Kundenstand sauber, damit das Team in Hamburg und Mysore planen kann. Sichtbarkeit: Du vertrittst uns auf Fachkongressen und in Verbandsformaten. Was Du mitbringst Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre nachweisbarer Erfolg im B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Dienstleistungen, idealerweise mit Entscheidern im Gesundheitswesen oder im Personaldienstleistungsmarkt. Aufbau-Erfahrung: Du hast schon einmal einen Outbound-Prozess von null aufgebaut und kannst Zahlen dazu nennen. Arbeitsweise: Du telefonierst gern, schreibst klar und hältst Termine ein. Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch sicher (Team in Indien). Mobilität: Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, gelegentlich Indien. Fachwissen: Pflege-Fachwissen ist kein Muss, Lernbereitschaft schon. Was wir bieten Ein Produkt mit echter Nachfrage: Messbare Wirkung, nämlich besetzte Stellen in Einrichtungen, die sonst Betten sperren müssten. Nah an den Gründern: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, Einblick in alle Teile des Geschäfts von Mysore bis zur Klinik. Rahmen: Festgehalt plus erfolgsabhängige Vergütung, wunderschönes, modernes Büro in Hamburg-Winterhude, Arbeit in einem hochmotivierten und ambitionierten Team. Indien: Reisen nach Mysore, um Kandidaten und Ausbildung selbst kennenzulernen. Vergiss das Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf, drei Sätze zu Deinem größten Vertriebserfolg und Deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Overview:</strong></p> <p>The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a field-based expert, that strategically drives the commercial objectives of selected genetic programs for Germany in the assigned territory. The KAM will be accountable for developing and implementing key account plans in their designated territory to optimize care for patients. The Key Account Manager, reporting to the Area Sales Lead, is expected to develop territory specific strategic account plans in the context of the overall product strategy and in close alignment with functions of Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Market Access and Commercial, while ensuring full compliance with the relevant company, industry, legal, regulatory and ethical standards.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Present a positive image of the company and develop awareness of Alnylam’s RNAi platform with relevant groups of healthcare professionals</li> <li>Develop, own, and drive territory and account plans, including customer targeting and cycle plan, in line with Marketing strategy and Business Operations guidance</li> <li>Achieve pre-launch and post-launch KPIs, including sales and volume targets</li> <li>Use advanced sales skills to ensure consistent and continuous messaging</li> <li>Perform detailed analysis of the assigned territory to identify, assess, and develop relevant centers for diagnosis and treatment</li> <li>Drive patient group identification, diagnosis and referral rates by strategic intersectoral referral network management in close cooperation with other field based functions</li> <li>Develop trusted relationships with a portfolio of customers to ensure market penetration, after developing a thorough understanding of key customer needs and requirements</li> <li>Ensure the correct products and services are delivered to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with internal stakeholders (commercial, supply chain, and compliance) and external centers</li> <li>Establish and maintain contact with key customers and provide commercial and scientific services to ensure access at site of care, and that logistics are in place to administer product</li> <li>Manage and execute local meetings to drive diagnosis and treatment rates, in collaboration with the Medical Affairs Team for physicians and other healthcare professionals</li> <li>Represent Alnylam at local and national events and congresses</li> <li>Serve as the link of communication between key customers and internal teams</li> <li>Liaise and collaborate with relevant internal staff (Medical Affairs, Sales Director, Marketing, Market Access and Business Operations), as required</li> <li>Steer regular local alignment meetings with other field based functions to ensure proper implementation and outcomes against the committed territory and account plans.&nbsp;</li> <li>Timely and accurate reporting and continuous diligent maintenance of the CRM database</li> <li>Conduct all activities to highest ethical standards in accordance with country code of practice and local Laws and regulations</li> <li>Significant domestic travel and occasional international travel as needed</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>University degree in a business-related field such as health or business management or comparable educational background</li> <li>Certified to promote medicinal products to national code of practice standard in Germany</li> <li>7+ years of Sales and Key Account Management experience in bio/pharmaceutical sales</li> <li>Ability to gain consistent access and develop strong &amp; professional relationships for product promotion with healthcare providers in reference centers and the community</li> <li>Effective communication and influencing skills to engage with professionals at all organizational levels</li> <li>Strong business acumen to add value to the existing health care structures.</li> <li>Ability to draw on previous experiences and insights to generate and maintain appropriate awareness and timely access to treatment</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills</li> <li>Fluent in German and English, both written and verbal</li> <li>Ability to travel within a territory on a regular basis (80% of the time)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Alnylam: </strong>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.</p> <p><strong>Our culture:</strong>&nbsp;Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.</p> <p>At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.</p> <p>Before applying, please review Alnylam's ⁠Candidate&nbsp;<a href="https://alnylampolicies.com/">Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;regarding how Alnylam handles Personal Data you provide with your application for employment.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Transport Manager (m/f/d)
description: <p>At AutoProff, we're looking for a new colleague&nbsp;to help manage and develop our supplier and transport network across Europe. This is a hands-on role with a mix of operational and commercial responsibilities, where you'll work closely with suppliers and colleagues across the business to ensure our operations run smoothly and efficiently.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As our new Senior Transport Manager, you will be responsible for managing supplier relationships, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring our supplier and transport network supports our business across Europe.</p> <p>You'll work closely with internal teams and external suppliers to ensure reliable supplier performance, support day-to-day operations, and identify opportunities to improve the way we work. While you'll be involved in supplier and transport contracts, you'll collaborate closely with <strong>AutoScout24's Procurement team</strong><strong>,</strong> who lead the commercial negotiations and sourcing activities, ensuring a consistent procurement approach across the group.</p> <p>The position can be based at our headquarters in <strong>Vejle, Denmark</strong>, or at our office in <strong>Düsseldorf, Germany</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the daily collaboration with suppliers</li> <li>Monitor supplier performance and service level agreements (SLAs).</li> <li>Follow up on delayed orders and resolve operational issues together with suppliers.</li> <li>Coordinate transport vendors to ensure efficient logistics operations.</li> <li>Implement and maintain suppliers</li> <li>Maintain supplier rebate and kickback agreements.</li> <li>Approve supplier invoices in Coupa.</li> <li>Support claims and handle supplier escalations.</li> <li>Ensure suppliers comply with contractual agreements and internal processes.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve processes and reduce costs.</li> <li>Maintain supplier data, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting.</li> <li>Work closely with Procurement, Operations, Finance, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The need-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Several years of experience in Supplier Management, Procurement, Logistics, Transport Management, or a similar role.</li> <li>Experience working with transport providers and logistics operations.</li> <li>Experience managing supplier performance and service level agreements.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to support decisions.</li> <li>Experience working with ERP or procurement systems (experience with Coupa is an advantage).</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Ability to manage several tasks and priorities at the same time.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in English and German or Danish</li> </ul> <p><strong>The nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience from an international technology, marketplace, automotive, or e-commerce company.</li> <li>Experience with transport sourcing and freight procurement.</li> <li>Experience handling supplier claims and disputes.</li> <li>Experience working with dashboards and KPI reporting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will thrive in this role if you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Enjoy working with both operational tasks and commercial discussions.</li> <li>Build good working relationships with suppliers and colleagues.</li> <li>Like solving problems and finding practical solutions.</li> <li>Work in a structured way and follow tasks through to completion.</li> <li>Are comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions within your area.</li> </ul> <p>If you think we could be a match, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!</p> <p><strong>About AutoProff</strong></p> <p>AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalise B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.</p> <p>in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialised pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.</p> <p>At AutoProff, we specialise in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.<br><br>With a focus on effective solutions, digitisation and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European dealers, including trade-ins cars, retail-ready cars, newer used fleet vehicles and insurance write-offs.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually. </p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du hast Lust unser Auktionsgeschäft voranzutreiben und wertvolle Erfahrungen im Online-Business zu sammeln? Dann suchen wir genau Dich!

Die Machineseeker Group betreibt mit den Online-Marktplätzen Maschinensucher, Machineseeker, TruckScout24, Gebrauchtmaschinen sowie Werktuigen das führende Netzwerk für gebrauchte Maschinen und Nutzfahrzeuge in Europa. Mehr als 12.000 Anbieter inserieren derzeit über 300.000 Maschinen auf den Plattformen. Über 15 Millionen monatliche Besucher erzeugen dabei ein jährlich vermitteltes Anfragevolumen von mehr als 120 Milliarden Euro. Seit 1999 wächst die Firma jedes Jahr profitabel, sodass wir unser Team in Essen fortlaufend verstärken.

Für unser Team am Standort Essen suchen wir ab sofort einen Manager Online Auctions (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wir setzen konsequent auf Working from Office. Mehr Innovationen („Gespräche an der Kaffeemaschine“), bessere Arbeitsbedingungen (Breitband, Klimaanlage, 3 Bildschirme, große Schreibtische etc.), optimale Einarbeitung, höhere Bindung, Schaffung Firmenkultur (inkl. Koch, Fitnessraum und -coach) sowie saubere Trennung Office/Wohnung.

Aufgaben

  • Du koordinierst die Kommunikation zwischen Verkäufern und Käufern und sorgst für effizienten Informationsfluss
  • Du entwickelst Ideen für Produktentwicklungen und Prozessverbesserungen und hilfst, den Verkaufskanal zu skalieren
  • Du führst Preisverhandlungen über rollierend siebenstellige Volumina
  • Du verantwortest die Erstellung der Exposés zur Versteigerung stehender Maschinen
  • Du lebst Unternehmertum aktiv und treibst unser digitales Geschäftsmodell voran
  • Du wirst Teil von einem dynamischen Team mit vielen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Qualifikation

  • Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurswissenschaften oder Ähnlichem oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss
  • Du bringst technisches Verständnis & eine hohe Affinität zu digitalen Geschäftsmodellen mit
  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und einen Blick für Details
  • Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut in Wort & Schrift
  • Du verfügst idealerweise bereits über Erfahrungen bei
    Maschinenbau-, Digital- oder Handelsunternehmen

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung
  • 38,5 Wochenstunden & 29 Urlaubstage im Jahr
  • Viel Verantwortung & Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einer der erfolgreichsten Internetfirmen des Ruhrgebiets
  • Möglichkeit, beim stark wachsenden Marktführer viel zu lernen
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Du mit Top-Performern zusammenarbeitest und selbst Höchstleistungen erreichst
  • Klimatisiertes, neues & großzügiges Büro (nur wenige Gehminuten vom Essener Hbf)
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & flache Hierarchien
  • Fitnessraum & Personal Trainer
  • Kostenlose Getränke & Verpflegung, inklusive Koch
  • Mobilitätszuschuss durch volle Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets
  • Ergonomische Stühle & höhenverstellbare Schreibtische
  • Individueller Englischunterricht bei Interesse
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents sowie Sommer- und Weihnachtsfest

title: Performance Ad Creative – Static & Video
description: Die Rolle Du bist Performance Ad Creative in unserem Growth Team. Unsere Performance-Agentur steuert Strategie, Testplan und Media Buying auf Meta und TikTok. Du baust die Ads: Statics und Video, Hooks und Varianten, in wöchentlichen Sprints. Aus jedem Gewinner machst du die nächste Generation. Dafür verbindest du Daten mit Kreativität. Du weißt, was im E-Commerce gerade funktioniert, liest die Zahlen deiner Ads und machst daraus die nächste Idee. Du entwickelst und produzierst selbst, von Konzept und Skript bis zum fertigen Asset. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Brand und Performance: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Creative Direction zusammen, nutzt die Bildwelt der Marke als Fundament und sorgst dafür, dass Qstar auch in schnellen Ads erkennbar bleibt. Im Growth Team arbeitest du mit Shop Lead, Creator Marketing und Organic Social zusammen und berichtest regelmäßig, welche Ads laufen, was gewinnt und was als Nächstes getestet wird. Was du machst Du baust unsere Performance-Creative-Pipeline auf: von Idee und Briefing über Produktion bis Test und Auswertung, als wiederholbaren Prozess. Du arbeitest in Wochensprints: jede Woche neue Ads in den Test, müde Ads werden ersetzt. Du entwickelst eigene Konzepte, Hooks und Formate für Meta und TikTok und baust Static- und Video-Ads selbst. Du liest Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Watch Time, CTR, CPM, Conversion Rate, CPA und ROAS, leitest daraus ab, was als Nächstes getestet wird, und multiplizierst, was gewinnt. Du arbeitest im Testplan der Agentur, bekommst ihre Learnings und lieferst, was sie zum Skalieren braucht. Du arbeitest mit dem Material, das da ist: Brand-Shootings, Bewegtbild aus dem Creative Department, Creator- und UGC-Content. Du zeigst, wo Shootings oder weitere Produktionen nötig sind. Templates und AI-Workflows sorgen für Tempo. Du bleibst am Puls: welche Formate im E-Commerce gerade performen, was die besten D2C-Brands machen. Dieses Wissen bringst du ins Team. Was du mitbringst Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung im Bau von Performance-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, in einer Agentur, einer Brand oder als Freelancer. Ein Portfolio mit echten Ads, die live waren. Du kannst erklären, warum sie funktioniert haben oder nicht. Du denkst in Hooks, den ersten drei Sekunden und Varianten, nicht in Einzelstücken. title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: We are looking for a  Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly! Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use. Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems. This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data. What you will do Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption. Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration. Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code. Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products. Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution. Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery. Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes. Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations. What we are looking for Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments. Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes. Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance. Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more. Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows. Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership. Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty. Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries. Useful experience, but not required DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems. Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems. GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems. Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing. Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations. Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby. What we offer you At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team. Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives. Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale. Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working. Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities. A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office. About Smartly Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally. We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected. Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities. About Smartly Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries.   • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.


2 reasons why you should not apply

  • You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.

  • You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.


Your mindset

  • You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.

  • You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.

  • You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.

  • You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.

  • You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.


What we offer

  • Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.

  • Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.

If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Senior Product Integrity Engineer</h1> <p><strong>About SharkNinja</strong></p> <p>SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company with a diversified portfolio of lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted global brands, Shark and Ninja, we bring disruptive innovation to market across multiple product categories, creating products that consumers love.</p> <p><strong>AI at SharkNinja</strong></p> <p>At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a technically strong, proactive and detail-oriented <strong>Senior Product Integrity Engineer</strong> to join our UK team, with a focus on design assurance, engineering validation and product quality.</p> <p>Embedded within the New Product Development (NPD) process, you will take ownership of product integrity activities from concept through to production launch, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and consumer expectations are built into the design.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to lead risk assessment and validation activities. You will use engineering judgement, test evidence and consumer insights to challenge designs, resolve risks and influence decisions at critical development milestones.</p> <p>This role offers broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to directly influence whether our products deliver SharkNinja’s 5-star quality standard.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Design assurance and engineering validation</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead product integrity input into design reviews, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), design verification and validation planning (DVP&amp;R), and safety reviews throughout the NPD lifecycle.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the development and delivery of risk-based verification and validation plans, establishing clear test methods, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements aligned with product specifications and applicable UK, European and other target-market requirements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Challenge design assumptions and assess product performance, reliability, robustness and foreseeable use conditions, ensuring risks are understood and addressed before tooling and production release.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate engineering changes for their impact on quality, safety and performance, defining appropriate revalidation requirements to prevent regression.</p> </li> <li> <p>Review and approve quality-related manufacturing and test documentation within your remit, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into production controls.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to Design for Manufacture (DFM) reviews, assessing tolerances, process capability and potential sources of manufacturing variation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide evidence-based recommendations on product readiness, escalating unresolved risks and driving corrective action ahead of development milestones.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional leadership and quality governance</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Represent product integrity within cross-functional NPD teams, translating consumer expectations and quality requirements into practical engineering decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead quality risk and action reviews, establishing clear ownership, priorities and closure criteria.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers to define process controls, quality gates and production acceptance criteria ahead of mass production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead technical investigation of issues identified during prototype, pilot and pre-production builds, coordinating root-cause analysis and verifying corrective action effectiveness.</p> </li> <li> <p>Challenge supplier 8D investigations and corrective action proposals, ensuring conclusions are supported by robust evidence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities addressing design and process gaps, tracking actions through to verified closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide technical guidance to colleagues and support the development of consistent product integrity practices across programmes.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Data analysis and continuous improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Analyse validation results, build data, test failures and relevant field performance insights to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define and monitor quality metrics, validation coverage and acceptance criteria throughout the development cycle.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply lessons from existing products to new designs, strengthening test coverage and preventing repeat failures.</p> </li> <li> <p>Improve validation methods and pre-production quality processes, addressing systemic gaps with sustainable solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate validation status, residual risks and corrective action progress clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Why At Dotmatics&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,&nbsp; we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.</p> <p><strong>We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.</strong></p> <p>We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.</p> <p>Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.</p> <p><strong>Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.</p> <p>You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.&nbsp; Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&amp;D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.</p> <p><strong>We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.&nbsp;</strong></p></div><div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <p><strong>What do we need</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application — writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.</p> <p>This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product.</p> <p>While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;In this role you will get to:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).</li> <li>&nbsp;Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.</li> <li>Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.</li> <li>Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.</li> <li>Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.</li> <li>Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.</li> <li>Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation — and be mentored by them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>You'll have <strong>2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation</strong>. You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.</p> <p>Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.</p> <p><strong>The Key Skills we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Practical experience with Cypress</strong> — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript</strong>, including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.</li> <li><strong>Experience with BDD / Cucumber</strong>, or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.</li> <li><strong>Test case design and documentation</strong> — the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with Git and GitHub</strong>, including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You may also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.</li> <li>Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.</li> <li>&nbsp;Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).</li> <li>&nbsp;Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.</li> <li>&nbsp;A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Research shows us the<a class="c-link" href="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/" target="_blank" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-stringify-link="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/">&nbsp;confidence gap</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics <a class="c-link" href="https://www.dotmatics.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-stringify-link="https://legal.hubspot.com/privacy-policy">Privacy Notice</a> explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.<span class="c-message__edited_label" data-sk="tooltip_parent">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.</p> <p>Learn more about #TaboolaLife on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?fetchDeterministicClustersOnly=true&amp;heroEntityKey=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A128707&amp;keywords=taboola&amp;origin=RICH_QUERY_SUGGESTION&amp;position=2&amp;searchId=dcc8bfbb-b05c-458e-a7f1-726d30e7dd80&amp;sid=9(y&amp;spellCorrectionEnabled=false"> LinkedIn</a>,<a href="https://www.facebook.com/taboola/"> Facebook</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/taboola.israel/?hl=en"> Instagram</a>,<a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BctKkw2Vj_EOjvy24kjRKq_ZxZzmZxweIqNLQgsLtcs/edit?tab=t.0"> X</a>,<a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6W0hdStO0jRVYhg4ABzjRw"> YouTube</a>, &amp; the<a href="https://blog.taboola.com/category/taboola-life/?_gl=1*1c2v1ec*_ga*MTI4NTM3OTcyNy4xNjkxNTA0MjA0*_ga_ERHENNM7DM*MTcxMDM1MDIwMi4yMjMuMS4xNzEwMzUwMjI5LjMzLjAuMA.."> Taboola Life Blog</a>.</p> <h3><strong>About Taboola</strong></h3> <p>Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.</p> <p>Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. title: Staff Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.&nbsp;</p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.&nbsp;</p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Role &amp; Team</h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Data Engineer</strong> at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.</p> <p>You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.</p> <p><strong>Time zone requirement: </strong>Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.</li> <li>Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.</li> <li>Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.</li> <li>Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.</li> <li>Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.</li> <li>Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure</li> <li>10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with <strong>Dagster</strong> — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)</li> <li>Proven track record building and operating <strong>data pipelines</strong> at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning</li> <li>Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices</li> <li>Strong <strong>system design</strong> skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them</li> <li>Practical experience designing <strong>service-oriented architecture</strong>, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations</li> <li>Strong <strong>Python</strong> skills and experience with <strong>Google Cloud</strong></li> <li>Experience with <strong>Pub/Sub</strong> and event-driven patterns</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product</li> <li>Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers</li> <li>Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice To Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored</li> <li>Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference</li> <li>Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production</li> <li>Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Note:</strong> We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.</em></p> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits&nbsp;</li> <li>Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around</li> <li>Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets&nbsp;</li> <li>A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values</li> <li>To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Our Team</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.</p> <p>We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Diversity &amp; Inclusion</strong></h2> <p>The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve.&nbsp;</p> <p>We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.</p> <h2><strong>Our Values</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.</strong></h4> <p>We act with urgency.</p> <h4><strong>Our curiosity fuels our growth.</strong></h4> <p>We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.</p> <h4><strong>We’re rooted in diversity.</strong></h4> <p>Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.</p> <h4><strong>We care for each other.</strong></h4> <p>We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.</p> <h4><strong>Trust is fundamental.</strong></h4> <p>We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.</p> <p>_________________________________</p> <p data-start="90" data-end="127"><strong data-start="90" data-end="125">Use of AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p><em>We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. All hiring decisions are always made by people, not machines. Any data processed by AI is handled securely in line with GDPR and our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice</a>.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div> <div class="attachment-overlay preview"> <div id="viewer-container"> <div id="canvas-container"> <div id="viewer" class="pdfViewer"> <div class="page" data-page-number="1" data-loaded="true"> <div class="textLayer"> <p><strong>About Tripadvisor</strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p><em>Job Location:&nbsp;</em><em>This role is a hybrid position based out of either our London or Oxford office.</em></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">&nbsp;</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About Bókun:</strong></p> <p>Bókun, a subsidiary of Tripadvisor, is a rapidly growing travel technology company that offers cutting-edge solutions to the Tours and Experiences industry. Our comprehensive suite of tools enables Tour Operators, Travel agencies, and OTAs to streamline their operations and expand their reach. At Bókun, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower our users to grow their businesses and enhance customer experiences.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>Bókun is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Customer &amp; Community Marketing Specialist to join our growth team. Reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you will be the recognised expert and driver of our customer success, engagement, and referral strategies.</p> <p>You will roll up your sleeves to execute day-to-day community programs while simultaneously designing the long-term, scalable frameworks. As a unique cross-brand initiative, you will lead community building and engagement across our whole supplier community working closely alongside a team of specialists in Content Marketing, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build &amp; Execute the Community Strategy: </strong>&nbsp;You'll develop, launch, and manage spaces where tour and attraction businesses can learn and network. This includes getting hands-on with designing and executing educational programs, webinars, newsletters, and social content for our global network of experience operators.</li> <li><strong>Drive Community Initiatives:</strong> You will directly manage and execute community-building efforts, content, and engagement strategies for the whole supplier community, sharing best practices across the entire Experience operator industry.</li> <li><strong>Drive the Referral Program:</strong> You'll collaborate directly with the PMM to enhance brand/product affinity and build scalable campaigns that drive a significant increase in customer referrals.</li> <li><strong>Own Customer Communication Channels:</strong> Take ownership of our primary customer communication channels, specifically leading initiatives and campaigns through platforms like Intercom and ActiveCampaign to drive consistent operator engagement.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Reactivation Campaigns</strong>: You will use quantitative and qualitative data research to understand root causes of suppliers who don’t upgrade from Free plans, building highly efficient, scalable frameworks for customer reactivation and retention in the process.</li> <li><strong>Brand Engagement &amp; Social Media Champion:</strong> You will actively develop and implement a hands-on brand engagement strategy and content plan for our community channels to increase reach, engagement, and ultimately drive qualified leads.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Mentorship:</strong> You'll collaborate seamlessly with Content, Partnerships, and Sales to integrate community initiatives into broader growth campaigns. As a Principal IC, you will act as a role model, proactively offering guidance, insights, and mentorship to junior team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 5 years of experience in community/customer marketing or a related field.</li> <li>Proven track record of building and nurturing online communities.</li> <li>Strong practical experience managing and executing campaigns through customer communication platforms such as Intercom and ActiveCampaign.</li> <li>Possesses "AI native thinking" to innovate and optimise how we interact with and empower our operator community.</li> <li>You don't just track basic metrics; you analyse trends to propose data-driven solutions and continuously improve recurring engagement activities.</li> <li>Comfortable speaking in-person and online to large audiences.</li> <li>Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to seamlessly balance responsibilities.</li> <li>Can effectively prioritise tasks and adjust strategies based on community feedback and needs.</li> <li>You are comfortable sharing complex insights with senior stakeholders and enjoy mentoring junior colleagues.</li> <li>Proactively identifies challenges, improves processes, and challenges the status quo.</li> <li>A keen interest and passion for travel, technology, and empowering tour and activity operators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses</li> <li>“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.</li> <li>Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li>Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li>Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li>Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li>Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li>Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li>Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li>Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We succeed together</strong></p> <p>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at ----- <p>If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at ----- We have all the answers!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-GM</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h2><strong>About Aiven</strong></h2> <p>Aiven is the open source based data platform that builders trust to run PostgreSQL®, Apache Kafka®, ClickHouse®, OpenSearch®, Valkey™ and more in production, on any cloud. Builders ship faster. Their companies run on data that stays available, secure and under control.</p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>You own the commercial relationship with a book of existing Aiven customers across the UK &amp; Ireland, worth more than $4m in ARR. Your job is to keep those customers, grow them, and turn their success into proof for the next customer. You spot risk early, and find the next use case before the customer asks for it.&nbsp;</p> <p>You also open new doors: cold and warm outreach into accounts that look like your best customers, from first conversation through close.</p> <p>You lead with AI from the front. It shapes how you plan, how you engage and what you say in every customer conversation. Agents do the research, monitoring and first drafts; you decide what matters and where to push. The outcome is growth: more ARR retained, more expanded and more pipeline created, earlier and more predictably.</p> <p>Why now: Aiven has ambitious growth plans, and we're on track. Every customer we serve is building AI, and AI depends on the data platform underneath it. Our open source based platform means no lock-in, so builders ship faster and our customers move with more innovation velocity. You sit at the centre of that, working with customers from Fintech and AI innovators through to Utilities whose AI ambitions depend on us.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Own the strategic partnership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Grow each account in your book beyond its current baseline in usage and commitments. This is the primary mandate of the role.</li> <li>Build and run an account plan for every priority account, with clear goals, stakeholders, risks and expansion opportunities across the Aiven platform.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers on technical validation, and bring in Product Engineering, Aiven leadership and executives where a customer needs senior backing.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Retain and grow ARR</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Spot contraction and churn risk early, using usage and sentiment signals surfaced by agents, then act on them before the customer does. Build a protection plan for each risk with the Aiven customer team.</li> <li>Find cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Aiven platform, and see them through to close.</li> <li>Run renewals as a plan, not an event. Know the commercial position, the decision makers and the competing options well before the renewal date. Lead commercial and contract negotiation through to signature.</li> <li>Qualify and manage every renewal, expansion and new logo opportunity with MEDDPICC.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Build relationships at every level</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Build relationships with the builders who use the Aiven platform day to day (engineering, platform and product leads) and the teams who consume the services it delivers.</li> <li>Build relationships with executives, budget holders and senior IT decision makers.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Turn happy customers into proof</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Use your relationships to build positive sentiment, then work with Marketing to turn it into events, webinars, case studies and references matched to the right prospect.</li> <li>Represent Aiven at UKI industry events, and feed customer, competitive and market insight back to Product, Engineering and leadership.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Open new doors</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own new logo opportunities in the UKI territory, from prospecting through close, using cold and warm outreach.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Run the book AI-native</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own how your work gets done: decide which tasks you do, which agents do and which stop entirely. Review this as the tools improve.</li> <li>Run account research, risk and usage monitoring, outreach drafting and forecasting through agents. Spend your time on judgment, relationships and negotiation.</li> <li>Keep Salesforce accurate so the forecast, and the agents reading it, reflect reality.</li> <li>Share what works with the team. The way you work is a product too.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience owning a book of existing customers in enterprise B2B software, with a record of retaining and growing ARR, managing renewals and churn risk, and negotiating contracts.</li> <li>Experience selling to technical users and to executive buyers, and adjusting your message for each.</li> <li>A structured approach to account planning and multi-threading.</li> <li>Clear communication in English, written and spoken.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your sales workflow, with examples of work you have redesigned or cut as a result.</li> <li>High agency: a record of owning accounts end-to-end and solving hard problems without waiting for a blueprint.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience co-selling with cloud providers and partners.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Comfort with usage-based or consumption pricing, and with using usage data to spot risk and opportunity.</li> <li>Experience selling open source based data technology.</li> <li>Experience running customer advocacy: references, case studies, event speakers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we measure success</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Quota attainment, net revenue retention and gross revenue retention for your book, against target.</li> <li>Expansion ARR from cross-sell and upsell, against target.</li> <li>Churn and contraction risks flagged early, each with a documented protection plan.</li> <li>Executive and budget holder coverage across priority accounts.</li> <li>Customer references, case studies and event speakers delivered each year.</li> <li>Pipeline creation, deal progression and on-time opportunity booking.</li> <li>Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene.</li> <li>Time spent on customer conversations vs. admin and research, trending the right way quarter on quarter.</li> <li>Workflow improvements adopted by the wider team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Role context</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Team: Field Sales EMEA South.</li> <li>Book: more than $4m ARR across existing customers.</li> <li>Customers: Fintech and AI innovators through to Utilities.</li> <li>Reports to: EMEA South Sales Director.</li> <li>First 90 days: learn the business, the technology, your customer base and how we work.</li> <li>Focus: existing customers first, with new logo opportunities in UKI.</li> <li>Works closely with: Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Support, Product Engineering, Marketing, Sales Development and Aiven leadership.</li> <li>Location: London, UK, with the right to work there. Hybrid working, with regular time together in the London hub for planning and deal reviews, and travel to customers as needed. Adjustments available.</li> </ul> <p class="p4">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p3">Equal Opportunities:</p> <p class="p5">Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>WHAT MAKES US EPIC?</h2> <p>At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.</p> <p>Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.</p></div><h2>ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH</h2> <h3><strong>What We Do</strong></h3> <p>Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.</p> <h2>MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES</h2> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.</p> <h3><strong>In this role, you will</strong></h3> <p>Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-backed interactive characters:</strong> LLMs for conversational characters, memory&nbsp;systems, automated evals, animation, etc.</li> <li><strong>Game agents: </strong>vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>3D human and object tracking</strong></li> <li><strong>Reinforcement learning </strong>for embodied behavior</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Speech systems and conversational agents</strong></li> <li><strong>World building and game logic generation</strong>: video models, 2D-&gt;3D scene building, etc.</li> <li><strong>AI-assisted game development</strong>, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant&nbsp;for UE and UEFN</li> <li><strong>Embodied and physical intelligence</strong> including human-object interaction</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Multi-modal diffusion models</strong></li> <li><strong>Player safety</strong>: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.</li> <li><strong>Improved user experience</strong>: personalised game recommendation, game representation,&nbsp;spam detection, etc.</li> <li><strong>Content localization</strong>: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.</li> <li><strong>Model distillation for realtime performance</strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field</li> <li>A record of publication in top conferences/journals</li> <li>Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing</li> <li>Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning</li> <li>Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning</li> <li>Excellent AI coding and experimental engineering skills</li> <li>Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Internship Details</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Duration:</strong> 5-12 months initially (depending on your location), with flexible start-dates&nbsp;throughout 2026/2027</li> <li><strong>Hours:</strong> full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week)</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Select regions within the UK, US or Canada</li> <li><strong>Employment Authorization</strong>: You must hold Epic interns is regularly published in top-tier conferences</li> </ul> <p><em>This internship has a flexible start date in 2026/2027. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit <a href="https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/earlycareers">epicgames.com/earlycareers</a>. This is going to be Epic!</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p>Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.</p> <h3><strong>Like what you hear? description: <p><strong>Department Overview:</strong></p> <p>Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. description: <p>Duetto's platform runs 24/7 for hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world, and that reliability doesn't happen by accident. Our customers depend on us around the clock, and that shows up in how seriously we take reliability</li> <li>Real collaboration, not silos. Come as you are, and bring your full self to the work</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Location: Remote, Croatia, Spain or UK</li> <li>Work model: Fully remote</li> <li>Weekly on-call rotation as last line of support for 24/7 services</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Duetto is an equal opportunity employer.
