title: Director, HR Business Partner for HR
description: <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at <a href="http://www.take2games.com/">http://www.take2games.com</a>.</p> <p>We are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.</p> <p><strong>The Challenge</strong></p> <p>The HR function at Take-Two is one of the most complex and high stakes client groups in the organization, spanning three labels (Take-Two, 2K, and Zynga), thousands of employees globally, and a leadership team navigating constant transformation. As the&nbsp;<strong>Director, HR Business Partner for HR</strong>, you won't just support the business, you are the business.</p> <p>In this role, you'll serve as the strategic partner to HR leadership teams across all three labels, helping translate enterprise HR strategy into actionable people programs, org design decisions, and operating plans. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, bringing the same rigor and partnership to the HR function that HRBPs bring to their client groups in the business every day. It's a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class people organization runs, from the inside.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Take On</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary strategic partner to the HR leadership teams across Zynga, 2K, and Take-Two, translating HR strategy into priorities, programs, and operating plans for the global HR function.</li> <li>Lead workforce planning and organizational design for HR teams, including role clarity, resourcing decisions, and structural recommendations, ensuring the function is built to support current and future business needs.</li> <li>Drive talent management for HR leaders and critical HR roles, including succession planning, leadership development, performance calibration, and targeted retention strategies.</li> <li>Advise on compensation, mobility, and promotions within the HR function in partnership with Total Rewards, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness.</li> <li>Lead and sponsor change initiatives that impact the HR function, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement, and change readiness from start to finish.</li> <li>Manage HR risk and employee relations escalations that arise within the HR function, coordinating with Legal and Employee Relations to resolve matters with discretion and confidentiality.</li> <li>Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that inform decision-making HR leaders, turning data into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Co-design and deliver HR programs in partnership with Centers of Expertise (Total Rewards, Talent, Learning, People Ops), sharing accountability for program quality and adoption across the function.</li> <li>Ensure compliance across HR policies and programs in partnership with Legal and Compliance, accounting for multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Finance and the SVP of HR to align HR headcount, operating spend, and investments to budget, with shared accountability for financial outcomes.</li> <li>Coordinate cross-functional HR initiatives with Business HRBPs and People Ops, ensuring consistent execution, clear handoffs, and alignment across the broader organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, including direct support of senior leadership (VP level and above) in a complex, matrixed organization.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience supporting an HR function as a client group, with an understanding of the unique dynamics of partnering with people professionals.</li> <li>Strong organizational design and workforce planning capabilities, with the ability to translate business strategy into structural and staffing recommendations.</li> <li>Track record leading talent management programs, including succession planning, leadership development, and performance calibration for senior and critical roles.</li> <li>Experience managing HR risk and employee relations escalations with sound judgment, discretion, and collaboration with Legal.</li> <li>Proficiency with people analytics, with the ability to synthesize data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Change management expertise, including planning, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement for large-scale initiatives.</li> <li>Exceptional stakeholder influence skills, with comfort pushing back, building consensus, and navigating competing priorities across multiple leadership teams.</li> <li>Working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional employment law, particularly across North America (US and Canada required; additional geographies a plus).</li> <li>Commercial acumen and budget awareness, with experience partnering with Finance on headcount planning and operating spend.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Great to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in the gaming, entertainment, or tech industry.</li> <li>Exposure to a multi-label or multi-brand corporate structure.</li> <li>Familiarity with HR tools and platforms used in enterprise-scale people operations (e.g., Workday).</li> <li>Coaching certification or formal leadership development training.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer You</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Great Company Culture</strong>. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Play Hard.</strong> Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.</li> <li><strong>Benefits</strong>. Medical (HSA &amp; FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning &amp; development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!</li> <li><strong>Perks</strong>. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games &amp; events, stocked pantries and more!</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (“T2”) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization.&nbsp; Employment at T2 is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.</em></p> <p><em>Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.</em></p> <p><em>Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Reporting to a Senior Director in IT, this role will lead teams responsible for enterprise planning and forecasting platforms, custom-built Finance solutions, and SaaS applications that complement the core SAP ERP ecosystem.</p> <p>The Director will lead a multidisciplinary team that includes planning model builders, systems analysts/product owners/TPMs, and software engineering professionals. enable greater use of data, automation, AI, and machine learning.</p> <p>A key responsibility of the role is strengthening the team’s ability to connect Finance domain expertise with specialized data and machine learning capabilities, enabling Finance to translate its AI and ML objectives into scalable solutions.</p> <p>The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and people leadership with Finance domain knowledge and experience across enterprise planning platforms, custom software development, SaaS solutions, integration architectures, data, and AI/ML technologies.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Finance Systems Leadership &amp; Business Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for planning and forecasting platforms, custom Finance solutions, and Finance-related SaaS applications.</li> <li>Partner with Finance leaders to understand business priorities and translate Finance transformation objectives into technology strategies, roadmaps, and solutions.</li> <li>Own the technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap balancing business priorities, technical debt, platform lifecycle, and operational sustainability.</li> <li>Establish engineering and product practices that balance speed, business value, user experience, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.</li> <li>Develop strong partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, ML Engineering, Integration, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other technology teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end solutions.</li> <li>Manage strategic technology vendors and implementation partners to ensure successful delivery, operational excellence, and continuous innovation.</li> <li>Build and develop a high performing organization across model building, systems analysis/product ownership, and software engineering disciplines while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Planning, Finance Applications &amp; Software Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technology leadership for enterprise-scale financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario-modeling solutions used across Finance.</li> <li>Lead the engineering, maintenance, and support of custom applications and services that address Finance-specific business requirements.</li> <li>Provide leadership for Finance SaaS applications adjacent to the core SAP ERP ecosystem.</li> <li>Ensure Finance solutions integrate effectively with SAP and the broader enterprise application and data ecosystem while maintaining appropriate architectural standards and controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI, ML and Data Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Finance leaders to identify opportunities where data, AI, and machine learning can improve planning, forecasting, financial analysis, automation, and decision making.</li> <li>Assess capability gaps and establish development plans, role expectations, and ways of working that prepare the Finance Systems Engineering organization to collaborate effectively with Data Engineering and ML Engineering teams.</li> <li>Enable teams to translate Finance business problems and domain knowledge into well-defined data, AI, and ML use cases.</li> <li>Partner with specialized technology teams to incorporate enterprise data, predictive models, and AI/ML services into Finance applications and business processes.</li> <li>Define how Finance Systems Engineering will evaluate, adopt, and govern AI and ML capabilities available through enterprise applications, internal data and ML platforms, and approved external services.</li> <li>Help drive adoption and operationalization of AI/ML capabilities within Finance while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, privacy, and technology standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.</li> <li>10+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise application or software engineering organizations in a large enterprise environment, including accountability for multidisciplinary teams, technology delivery, and operational performance.</li> <li>5+ years leading through managers, including responsibility for organizational design, talent development, performance management, and succession planning.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, enterprise applications, planning applications, systems analysis, product ownership, and technical program management</li> <li>Experience leading enterprise scale financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario-modeling platforms, including responsibility for platform strategy, delivery, lifecycle management, and operational performance.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Finance processes, particularly financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and related Finance operations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business leaders, translate business and transformation objectives into technology strategy and execution, and own multi-year portfolio roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical debt, platform lifecycle, and operational sustainability.</li> <li>Strong understanding of software engineering, enterprise architecture, integration, data, and cloud concepts.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop technical talent and build new capabilities within an engineering organization, including preparing teams to partner effectively with Data Engineering and ML Engineering and to operationalize data, AI, and machine learning capabilities.</li> <li>Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross functional leadership skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with one or more enterprise-scale planning and forecasting platforms, such as Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, or SAP Analytics Cloud, including solution design, model governance, integration, or platform administration.</li> <li>Experience leading software engineering teams building custom enterprise solutions using Golang, Java or comparable programming languages.</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures and enterprise integration patterns.</li> <li>Experience leading a portfolio of Finance SaaS solutions, such as Coupa, Rightsline, or comparable platforms, including vendor management, integration, lifecycle planning, and operational governance.</li> <li>Experience with SAP S/4HANA and integration of Finance applications and services with the core ERP environment.</li> <li>Experience in jointly delivering production AI or machine learning capabilities with Data Engineering and ML Engineering teams, including integration into enterprise applications or business processes.</li> <li>Understanding of how AI and machine learning can be applied responsibly to Finance use cases, including forecasting, predictive insights, anomaly detection, decision support, and process automation, with attention to data governance, security, privacy, and enterprise technology standards.</li> <li>Experience Space to share your skills through training sessions and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring! raw.title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
raw.description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

Education

Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. Nos valeurs fondamentales constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nos différences font notre unicité et notre force, à mesure que nous œuvrons à créer un environnement où chacun se sent à sa place et soutenu, quelle que soit son identité.

SumUp est fier d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, recherchant et accueillant activement la diversité au sein de ses équipes. Nous ne fondons nos décisions de recrutement ou d'emploi sur aucun critère de race, de couleur, de religion ou de conviction religieuse, d'origine ethnique ou nationale, de nationalité, de sexe, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, de handicap, d'âge, ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi applicable ou interdit par la politique de l'entreprise. Notre engagement va au delà du recrutement pour créer un lieu de travail sûr et respectueux, où toute forme de harcèlement est strictement interdite. Découvrez-en davantage sur notre culture et nos opportunités sur notre site carrières, et suivez notre actualité sur LinkedIn, Instagram et TikTok.

description: Chez  Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. Votre rôle Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec. Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels. À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes. Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes : Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives. Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes. Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software. Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware. Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées. Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente. Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données. Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système. Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances. Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes. Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes. Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes. Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business. Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages. Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée. Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec. Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes. Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation. Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus. Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec. Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances. description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS   Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).   Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).       VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.   VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.   VOTRE PROFIL  Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.   Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.  Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel.    Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth. About the role To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris. You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire. A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions. You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role. You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department. We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices. What you will do Manage recruitment processes from A to Z , from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature. Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy. Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles , including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles. Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting , identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications. Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches. Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment. Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process. Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience. Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process. Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators. Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges. Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes. Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices. What we are looking for You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment. You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team. You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant. You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach. Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels. You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly. You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders. You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals. You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers. Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role. You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets. What's in it for you A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture. The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles. Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries. A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise. The opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our recruitment practices and have a visible impact on how we attract and hire talent. An office in the heart of Paris, close to Opéra Garnier. A hybrid working model, with up to 2 days of remote work per week. Lunch vouchers (€11/day via Swile). High-quality IT equipment. Regular company and team events Salary range for the role An annual gross package (fix +performance based bonus) ranging from 50 000 euros to 55 000 euros. Interested in joining us? Let’s talk.   As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history. Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.


Nach einer intensiven internen Einarbeitungsphase (Vormontage und Anlagenmontage) unterstützen Sie unser Team als erfahrener Field Engineer.


So schaffen Sie Mehrwert

  • Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben zählen neben selbst durchgeführten mechanischen Montagetätigkeiten, die personelle und fachliche Führung von kleineren bis mittleren Montageteams.

  • Bereitschaft für Montageeinsätze im In- und Ausland (Reisetätigkeit bis zu 60 %)

  • Verantwortlich für die fach- und termingerechte Montage beim Kunden

  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunde, Lieferant und interner Projektleitung sind sie es gewohnt präzise zu kommunizieren

  • Durchführen der Abnahmevalidierungen unserer eigenen mechanischen Analgenteile zur Qualitäts- und Gefahrenkontrolle.

  • Ihre ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Koordination, Organisation und Überwachung verhelfen Ihnen zu einer erfolgreichen Bewältigung dieser anspruchsvollen Tätigkeit.


Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Mechaniker oder Anlagen- und Apparatebauer mit einigen Jahren Berufserfahrung

  • Sie bringen einige Jahre Praxiserfahrung als leitender Monteur für mechanische Anlagen / Maschinen mit

  • Muttersprache Deutsch, gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Sie verfügen über gute PC-Kenntnisse in MS Office, AutoCAD DWG Viewer

  • Offene, selbständige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit

Unser Angebot

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Wir bieten ein umfassendes Aufgabengebiet in einem agilen KMU

  • Eine sorgfältige Einführung in Ihr Fachgebiet

  • Gute Sozialleistungen und ein zeitgemässes Lohnsystem

  • Ein motiviertes Team

Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem agilen KMU, das Freiraum für Kreativität und Weiterentwicklung gibt.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department. The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.   What you will do Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience. Contribute well tested and production ready code. Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting. Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals. Experience and qualifications MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience). 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience. Proficiency with Java. Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance   Nice to have Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.  Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.   We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department.

The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.

 

What you will do

  • Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience.

  • Contribute well tested and production ready code.

  • Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting.

  • Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals.


    • Experience and qualifications
  • MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

  • 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Proficiency with Java.

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance

    •  

    Nice to have

  • Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;research projects in efficient LLM and VLM&nbsp;inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT),&nbsp;distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes&nbsp;using&nbsp;PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks,&nbsp;and collaborate&nbsp;with MLEs and platform engineers to&nbsp;turn them into&nbsp;production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). model/system&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A&nbsp;PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications&nbsp;at venues such as&nbsp;NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or&nbsp;HPCA.</li> <li>Experience deploying ML In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;index=11&amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong>&nbsp;<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1917&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Role:&nbsp;<br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p></p> <p>You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.</p> <ul> <li>Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification</li> <li>Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.</p> <p>Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills</li> <li>Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern. Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Die Rolle Als Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc (a) bietest du qualitativ hochwertige, digitale Ernährungsberatung für Patientinnen und Patienten im Rahmen unseres integrierten Gesundheit Ökosystems an. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % im Homeoffice. Du konzentrierst dich voll und ganz auf die direkte, virtuelle Betreuung sowie den engen interdisziplinären Austausch mit unserem medizinischen Fachpersonal (Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychotherapeut/-innen sowie Medizinische Praxisassistent/-innen). Pflege der Behandlungsdossiers: Sorgfältige und zeitnahe Dokumentation aller Therapieverläufe über unsere Plattformen (u. a. OCS und Tomedo). Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Aktive Teilnahme an regelmässigen Fallbesprechungen und Rapporten mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Psychotherapeut/-innen und MPAs zur Sicherung einer ganzheitlichen Patientenversorgung. Bewilligung: Eine gültige Berufsausübungsbewilligung (BAB) für deinen Wohnkanton ab dem ersten Arbeitstag. Kommunikationsstärke: Freude am täglichen, vertrauensvollen Austausch mit Patientinnen und Patienten sowie im interdisziplinären Team. Was von Vorteil ist: Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten). Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Großbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschließlich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Komm zu uns und werde Teil des Teams, das diese Zukunft möglich macht!

Die Stelle

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unser medizinisches Fachpersonal im Praxisalltag unterstützt. In dieser Rolle bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Patient*innen und trägst massgeblich zu einer positiven Patient Experience bei. Die Stelle bietet dir die Möglichkeit, wertvolle klinische und administrative Praxiserfahrung parallel zu deinem Studium zu sammeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Patientenempfang: Du leitest den professionellen Empfangsbereich und setzt durch deine Kommunikation und Empathie den Standard für die Patient Experience.

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst proaktiv Lücken in administrativen Abläufen und empfiehlst eigenständig Verbesserungen.

  • Laborunterstützung: Neben administrativen Tätigkeiten unterstützt du das medizinische Team aktiv bei Laborarbeiten.

Dein Profil:

  • Medizinische Grundfertigkeiten (Essenziell): Du beherrschst die Blutentnahme und bist idealerweise sicher im Legen von Infusionszugängen und dem Verabreichen von Infusionen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke & Empathie: Du besitzt exzellente zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und einen ruhigen, einfühlsamen Kommunikationsstil im Umgang mit unseren Patient*innen.

  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Du hast die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig an deinen Aufgaben zu arbeiten als auch proaktiv zu gemeinsamen Teamzielen beizutragen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

  • Studienstatus: Du bist aktuell immatrikulierte*r Medizinstudent*in (idealerweise im klinischen Abschnitt) und suchst nach einer praktischen Tätigkeit neben dem Studium.

  • Zusätzliche Erfahrung (Wünschenswert): Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung in der Gesundheitsadministration oder im medizinischen Sekretariat sowie Kenntnisse in der Terminplanungssoftware oder elektronischen Patientenakten mit.

 

Was Ovivamed Dir bietet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen mit Adipositas und Typ-2-Diabetes revolutioniert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind. Bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment?
