Keeping those systems — and the people who use them — secure is not a compliance checkbox. It's the core infrastructure for a company operating across 112 countries.</p> <p>The PSI (Platform, Security &amp; Infrastructure) team is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own the security of Flexport's corporate environment: endpoints, identity systems, internal networks, and the SaaS estate. This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role, and not a role where you write policies and hope for the best. You'll build, automate, and be on the ground when things get real.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>Endpoint &amp; SaaS security</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and mature our endpoint security stack (EDR) across macOS and Windows fleets</strong>, writing device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules — with staged rollout and rollback built in.</li> <li><strong>Own security configuration and monitoring for Flexport's critical SaaS applications</strong> (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar) through SSPM tooling, catching risky OAuth grants and configuration drift before they become incidents.</li> </ul> <p>Access management</p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Flexport's identity posture:</strong> SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA and passkey rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.</li> <li><strong>Lead Flexport's zero-trust journey</strong> — making sure the right people have the right access, with the right controls, verified continuously.</li> </ul> <p>Detection &amp; response</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build and tune detection rules in our SIEM</strong>, turning signal into actionable alerts, not noise.</li> <li><strong>Lead incident response for security events:</strong> triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective.</li> </ul> <p>Vulnerability &amp; risk management</p> <ul> <li><strong>Run regular assessments of corporate endpoints</strong> and prioritize findings by real business risk.</li> <li><strong>Manage vendor and third-party security reviews</strong>, working with procurement and legal to evaluate risk before it lands in our environment.</li> </ul> <p>Security enablement &amp; leadership</p> <ul> <li><strong>Partner with IT, Engineering, and People teams</strong> to embed security into the way we work without creating friction that drives people to workarounds.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation</strong> that make the whole team more capable, and mentor engineers earlier in their career.</li> <li><strong>Bring a point of view on how agentic AI tools and browser-based AI assistants change what corporate security needs to watch for</strong>.</li> </ul> <h2>You Should Have</h2> <ul> <li>Typically <strong>5–8 years of experience</strong> in enterprise security, corporate IT security, or information security engineering — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply.</li> <li><strong>Strong working knowledge of endpoint security tooling:</strong> DLP (Cyberhaven, Purview, Varonis, or similar) and EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).</li> <li><strong>Practical SIEM experience</strong>, writing detection logic, triaging alerts, and reducing false positive noise.</li> <li><strong>Experience leading or playing a significant role in security incident response.</strong></li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of cloud environments</strong> (AWS, GCP, or Azure).</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with network security in a cloud-first environment (ZTNA, SASE, DNS filtering).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform) for security configuration management.</li> <li>Familiarity with SCIM, OIDC, and fine-grained authorization at scale.</li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth, global technology company.</li> <li>Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar, for automating detection, response, and operational tasks.</li> <li>Exposure to privacy regulations relevant to a European and global context (GDPR, etc.).</li> </ul> <h2>How We Work</h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.</li> <li>We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.</li> <li>We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Is Special</h2> <ul> <li>Broad ownership: you're not a cog in a large security org — you own the corporate security posture end to end, from endpoints to observability to incident response.</li> <li>Real stakes: Flexport operates in 112 countries with a global workforce. Security here matters at a genuine scale.</li> <li>Build, don't just operate: we want to automate and engineer our way to a stronger posture, not just run playbooks.</li> <li>You're part of PSI: the platform, security, and infrastructure teams work hand in hand at Flexport. We value engineering quality and treat security as infrastructure, not just policy.</li> <li>We sponsor visas for the right candidate.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you'll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.</li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on a daily basis.</li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam.</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full-time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport.</li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme.</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your family during one of the most important times in life — the birth of a child. title: Quality Platform Lead
description: At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust. Who we're looking for We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces. This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive. Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one. Where you'll start Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack Mobile: Patrol (Flutter) Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack Mobile: Patrol (Flutter) Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling The tooling can stay as it is. With a clear case you can migrate or rebuild. E2E coverage today is thin, so a different platform is genuinely on the table if it serves speed, maintainability and DX better. We have no predefined answer. AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight. What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios. How the role works Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes. Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role. Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that. What you'll own Quality strategy and platform Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health Decide whether to keep, evolve or replace the current tooling, with clear trade-offs on speed, maintainability and DX Set coding standards and patterns for test code, and keep the suite focused on the tests that earn their place Release gates and telemetry Build automated release gates into CI/CD and define what protects the core journeys Give Product, Engineering and leadership real-time quality telemetry on release readiness, risk and pipeline health Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on Risk-based coverage and testability Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps Developer enablement Make it easy for product engineers to write, run and maintain tests locally and in CI Embed quality into how teams plan and ship, and mentor the insourced QA Engineer Drive a measurable increase in developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX What success looks like in 12 months Platform ownership. You have taken over the automation platform across products and own it outright, with direction, standards and health all unambiguous, whether you kept the tooling or replaced it. Gates and focus. Release gates on the core journeys are fast and deterministic, and testing effort sits on the highest-risk scenarios. Dev ownership and satisfaction. Writing and maintaining tests is a routine part of Definition of Done, and developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX has measurably improved. Telemetry. Eng and Product work from live release-readiness and risk dashboards, failures triage cleanly, and flaky tests go into quarantine. Less manual drag. Regular releases go out without manual testing, with exploratory testing reserved for major new work. Who you are You have a track record of building or overhauling automation platforms (SWE / QE / SDET) You write production-grade code across app, test and infra repos. Language matters less to us than depth, though our stack today leans on TypeScript/JS, Elixir, Go, Python and Dart. You use AI agents effectively in your own engineering workflow and can judge where they belong inside a quality platform, from test generation to failure triage You have cross-platform web and mobile automation judgment, and can weigh unified toolchains against separate ones objectively You have deep CI/CD and test infrastructure experience: GitHub Actions, device clouds, parallelisation, test data You can translate quality risk into telemetry and decisions that Eng, Product and leadership act on You are a hands-on builder who wants to code the platform yourself You design platforms developers adopt, and you prioritise risk-based coverage Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background. Why join us now? Full ownership of the quality strategy and the automation platform, with a mandate for enablement We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. raw.title: Quality Platform Lead
raw.description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces.

This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive.

Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one.

Where you'll start

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

The tooling can stay as it is. With a clear case you can migrate or rebuild. E2E coverage today is thin, so a different platform is genuinely on the table if it serves speed, maintainability and DX better. We have no predefined answer.

AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight.

What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios.

How the role works

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role.

Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that.

What you'll own

Quality strategy and platform

  • Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health

  • Decide whether to keep, evolve or replace the current tooling, with clear trade-offs on speed, maintainability and DX

  • Set coding standards and patterns for test code, and keep the suite focused on the tests that earn their place

Release gates and telemetry

  • Build automated release gates into CI/CD and define what protects the core journeys

  • Give Product, Engineering and leadership real-time quality telemetry on release readiness, risk and pipeline health

  • Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on

Risk-based coverage and testability

  • Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs

  • Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest

  • Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps

Developer enablement

  • Make it easy for product engineers to write, run and maintain tests locally and in CI

  • Embed quality into how teams plan and ship, and mentor the insourced QA Engineer

  • Drive a measurable increase in developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX

What success looks like in 12 months

  1. Platform ownership. You have taken over the automation platform across products and own it outright, with direction, standards and health all unambiguous, whether you kept the tooling or replaced it.

  2. Gates and focus. Release gates on the core journeys are fast and deterministic, and testing effort sits on the highest-risk scenarios.

  3. Dev ownership and satisfaction. Writing and maintaining tests is a routine part of Definition of Done, and developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX has measurably improved.

  4. Telemetry. Eng and Product work from live release-readiness and risk dashboards, failures triage cleanly, and flaky tests go into quarantine.

  5. Less manual drag. Regular releases go out without manual testing, with exploratory testing reserved for major new work.

Who you are

  • You have a track record of building or overhauling automation platforms (SWE / QE / SDET)

  • You write production-grade code across app, test and infra repos. Language matters less to us than depth, though our stack today leans on TypeScript/JS, Elixir, Go, Python and Dart.

  • You use AI agents effectively in your own engineering workflow and can judge where they belong inside a quality platform, from test generation to failure triage

  • You have cross-platform web and mobile automation judgment, and can weigh unified toolchains against separate ones objectively

  • You have deep CI/CD and test infrastructure experience: GitHub Actions, device clouds, parallelisation, test data

  • You can translate quality risk into telemetry and decisions that Eng, Product and leadership act on

  • You are a hands-on builder who wants to code the platform yourself

  • You design platforms developers adopt, and you prioritise risk-based coverage

Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background.

Why join us now?

  • Full ownership of the quality strategy and the automation platform, with a mandate for enablement

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

design and implement durable fixes.</li> <li>Drive process harmonization and simplification to reduce manual steps, handoffs, rework, and off-cycle runs; make full use of Nmbrs functionality, integrations, and reporting.</li> <li>Lead payroll execution during transitions (new entity launches, provider or system changes, restructures/M&amp;A), ensuring continuity and control.</li> <li>Ensure payroll accounting remains clean as scope changes: consistent journals, accruals, reversals, and reconciliation standards.</li> <li>Monitor preventative controls by design, including SOX-aligned payroll controls; improve evidence pack quality and audit readiness.</li> <li>Act as escalation owner for complex or sensitive pay issues; provide authoritative explanations to employees and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Partner with HR Ops, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Nmbrs, and international payroll providers to deliver scalable operating models and service quality.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>At least 7+ years of Dutch payroll experience, including multi-entity scope in complex environments (growth, change, or hybrid in-house/outsourced models).</li> <li>Hands-on Nmbrs experience: running payroll end to end, configuring wage components and journal mappings, managing loonaangifte and corrections, and using its reporting and integrations (HRIS, GL, pension and benefits providers).</li> <li>Deep working knowledge of Dutch payroll compliance: loonheffingen and social security, WKR, the 30% ruling, expatriate taxation and shadow payroll, pension administration, sick leave and statutory leave, termination settlements, and year-end reporting.</li> <li>Working knowledge of international payroll (running or overseeing outsourced country payrolls) and readiness to act as the designated backup for the company’s other payrolls.</li> <li>Strong payroll controllership skills: ability to design controls, enforce SoD/approvals, and ensure audit-ready evidence.</li> <li>Proven capability improving payroll processes (standardization, automation enablement, reducing manual effort and errors) and leading transitions (vendor/system/new entity) with structured planning and issue resolution.</li> <li>Strong payroll accounting knowledge and experience working with Finance during close and audits.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management; comfortable acting as an escalation owner and payroll authority.</li> <li>Fluent English and professional working proficiency in Dutch (statutory correspondence, legislation, and provider documentation are in Dutch).</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">It will be an added bonus if you have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Dutch payroll qualification (PDL and/or VPS) and/or Nmbrs certification.</li> <li>Experience with international payroll providers or aggregators and multi-country operating models (SLAs, KPIs, remediation).</li> <li>Experience operating payroll controls in a SOX-compliant, US-listed company environment.</li> <li>Experience with equity compensation payroll (RSUs/options), including cross-border cases and trailing tax liabilities.</li> <li>Experience supporting Global Mobility programs: shadow payroll set-up, tax equalization/protection and hypothetical tax, gross-ups, and year-end assignee reconciliations with tax advisors.</li> <li>Experience turning statutory/operational requirements into system/workflow requirements (e.g., Nmbrs–HRIS–GL integrations).</li> <li>Project management certification or comparable experience leading cross-functional initiatives.</li> </ul> <h4>Competencies &amp; Behavioral Traits:</h4> <ul> <li>Systems thinking: redesigns the process so it scales, rather than adding checks and manual work.</li> <li>Bias for prevention: anticipates issues and builds guardrails.</li> <li>Influence without authority; can align multiple stakeholders around standards.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and change; makes decisions with incomplete information.</li> <li>Reliability and ownership: a dependable backup who keeps continuity across payrolls when it matters most.</li> <li>Strong coaching mindset; elevates capability across the payroll team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving&nbsp;- Bold thinking&nbsp;- Constant growth&nbsp;- Meaningful impact&nbsp;- Trust and real ownership&nbsp;- Opportunity to shape the future of AI&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. •        Write and support backend code in .Net 8.0+ using some of the most common libraries (Newtonsoft.Json, OpenTelemetry, Swagger, Bogus, AutoBogus, Moq);

•        Participate in the .NET implementation of a micro-services solution, being able to write backend code in a reliable, fast, scalable, and secure way, satisfying requirements and service level agreements;

•        Write and support services that read/transform/write data from multiple sources to multiple destinations (APIs, SQL Server, Elasticsearch, Redis, ActiveMq, Graph databases, csv files);

•        Review and approve Pull Request created by teammates;

•        Implement validation mechanisms as unit and integration tests;

•        Create and manage build and release pipelines and TestPlans in Azure Devops;

•        Create and manage Kubernetes helm charts for all supported applications and services;

•        Write and support complex SQL Server Stored Procedures;

•        Create Kibana dashboards and Elasticsearch queries;

•        Write OAUTH mechanisms. ADFS knowledge is a plus;

•        Work comfortably within a team. Follow SCRUM methodology procedures and disciplines; Estimate the work to be done upon request;

•        Write technical documentation;

•        Account for secure coding practices, as well as logging and auditing features;

•        Communicate in a clean, concise way, not only to peers but also to upper layers when needed.


More than 15 years in IT

More than nine years of experience in Software Development

More than five years of experience in Back-End Development with .Net Framework in the past seven 7 years

More than three years of experience in designing and developing scalable back-end components (REST APIs, integrations, micro-services)

More than two years of experience with containers and orchestrators (e.g Kubernetes or Docker Swarm)

Experience in more than one production-ready projects with OAUTH standard

More than three years of experience in working in an agile/scrum environment

More than two years of experience with highly scalable systems

More than one year of experience in working in an international/multi-cultural environment

Good knowledge of application development environments

Good knowledge of the micro-services design patterns

Good knowledge of asynchronous programming and messaging patterns

Good knowledge of .Net Framework 8.0+ (C#)

Good knowledge of Git and the main branch strategies (git flow)

Good knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server)

Good knowledge of message brokers (ActiveMq, RabbitMq or Apache Kafka)

Good knowledge of CI/CD systems such as Microsoft Azure Devops (e.g. Pipelines, Artifacts, TestPlans)

Good knowledge of OOP paradigms and SOLID principles

Ability to draft clear and complete documentation for full stack solutions (including design and architecture)

Knowledge of using Linux shell and basic Linux concepts (e.g., users, groups, rights)

Deadline 27/10/26

Only EU Citizens

Delivery mode: Remote from Europe

title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Netherlands. Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence. In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems. Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation. Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities. Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms. This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available. Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability. Accountabilities As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include: Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models. Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness. Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs). Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness. Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs. Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail. Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems. Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability. Requirements We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment. Native or near-native fluency in Arabic, with a strong understanding of grammar, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances. Current residence in Poland for this opportunity. Good English proficiency to understand project instructions and communicate effectively. Comfort using digital tools, online platforms, and web-based applications. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic, factual, and contextual inconsistencies. Good analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating content for accuracy and relevance. Cultural awareness and an understanding of Arabic-speaking communities, communication styles, and regional language variations. Ability to follow detailed guidelines, work independently, and deliver consistent, high-quality results. Curiosity about artificial intelligence, language technologies, and how human feedback can improve AI systems. Flexibility to participate in projects of varying durations and complexity, depending on your availability. Previous experience in data annotation, content evaluation, translation, linguistics, prompt engineering, or AI training may be helpful, but project-specific requirements will vary. Benefits Flexible, remote work: Contribute to suitable projects from your preferred working environment, subject to individual project requirements. Control over your availability: Choose whether to participate when a project matches your schedule and interests. Project-based opportunities: Access assignments that may last from a few days to several weeks, depending on scope and demand. Transparent compensation: Receive project-specific details about payment, tasks, and timelines before deciding whether to participate. Practical AI experience: Develop your understanding of AI training, data annotation, language evaluation, and large language models. Meaningful contribution: Help build more accurate, inclusive, and culturally aware AI technologies. Global contributor community: Become part of an international network of people contributing their linguistic and cultural expertise. Opportunities to grow: Build relevant skills through exposure to different projects and evolving AI technologies. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!  Why Apply Through Jobgether?     Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. title: Werkstudent Claims & Legal
description: Over ons   Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.   Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.   Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen. Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.   Hoe wij werken   Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit: Doorzettingsvermogen : We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen. Impact : We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons.  Zorg : Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel. Ondernemerschap : Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.     Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren. Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.   We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.   Operations Team   Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken. Jouw rol   Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.   Als  werkstudent Claims & Legal Support  ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.   Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt. Jouw profiel Aanspreekpunt voor klanten.  Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces. Claims behandelen.  Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie. Meedenken in complexe dossiers.  Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren. Samenwerken met Legal.  Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent  Verzekeringsrecht  of  Nederlands Recht  heeft onze voorkeur.  Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal.  Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden;  Wat wij bieden   Concurrerende vergoeding  - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past. Pensioenregeling  - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage. Reiskostenvergoeding  - We helpen reizigers met hun woon-werkverkeer. Hybride werken - Mogelijkheid om twee keer per week vanuit huis te werken. Als ervaren professional kun je remote werken en kom je af en toe naar kantoor. 25 vakantiedagen per jaar  - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!) Abonnement op Alleo  - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats! Leuke events  - Maandelijkse team drinks, kwartaal uitjes, lunch & learns, feesten, merch en FUN! Bedrijfs MacBook  - Krijg de beste laptop om je werk snel en efficiënt te doen! Snelle carrièreontwikkeling  - Er is geen betere plek om je carrière te ontwikkelen. Wij groeien en jij kunt met ons meegroeien! Interne leiderschapsprogramma’s en coaching.
